title: Fix Scene Not Showing in MCP App
description: Fix Scene Not Showing in MCP App
summary:
Fixed two bugs causing the scene not to show in the MCP app:

1. **`_enrich_design` shallow-design bug** (`compose/engine/main.py`): `flattenDesignDict` reads the design from `kit["designs"]`, which may have a shallow entry (no pieces) when the session design was hydrated from a sibling `.design.compose.json` file. Fixed by injecting the full session design into a shallow-copied kit before calling `flattenDesignDict`, ensuring all pieces receive `plane`/`center` values.

2. **Vitest config hardcoded root** (`elements/ui/vitest.config.ts`): The shared vitest config used `root: dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` which always resolved to `elements/ui/`, so `compose/ui`'s `npm test` ran `elements/ui/index.tsx` tests instead of `compose/ui/index.tsx`. Fixed by switching to `root: process.cwd()` — each bundle's test command now runs its own in-source tests.

Results: elements/ui 12/12 pass, compose/ui 194/194 pass (previously 0 compose/ui tests ran), Python 57/57 pass.
